title: Counters, list and the one owner write
requirement: The State counters, the task list and the two board/mode toggles read the state/views projections and the session snapshot, with no file write; the panel has exactly two command call sites — designmap's read-only views and the taskboard owner-status write (the owner changes a task status: the board owns the row, mirrors the TASK and records the override in the journal; a TASK with no boardId is refused no_board_row and a refusal keeps its code). A task linked through reqIds shows every requirement, not only reqId. A broken read shows — and a message in title instead of breaking the header and the button keeps opening the panel.
steps: assert the client source declares no workspaceFiles.write call and exactly two command call sites: designmap views (read) and taskboard owner-status (the owner write)
assert the owner-status path is a two-call compare-and-set: read the board row, then one owner-status op; a TASK with no boardId sends no command and answers no_board_row; a refusal keeps its code
assert requirementIdsOf folds reqId and reqIds so a batch task shows both requirements in the card, the drawer, the filter and the count
assert the counter error path renders — with the error in title and keeps the click handler that opens the panel
assert the list reads title/steps/updatedAt from the entity frontmatter rather than writing anything back
run the test on the fixed files: exit 0, violations 0; the same test on the shipped 0.1.36 client names the missing helpers and the one command call site (red, recorded in the analysis trace)
expected: The test exits 0 with zero violations on the fixed files; against the shipped 0.1.36 client it fails by name on the missing requirement/status helpers, the single command call site and the absent status control. It names a workspaceFiles.write call, a third command call site or a missing error path if any returns.
